reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported database: SQLite driver better-sqlite3. Deployz hosts PostgreSQL and MySQL only; an embedded file database does not survive in the container model.
reviews.reason: No shown line selects PostgreSQL or MySQL instead of SQLite; the app stores its database under DATA_DIR, so the SQLite requirement holds.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares meilisearch (getmeili/meilisearch:v1.41.0) in docker/docker-compose.yml. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The production compose file points the web app at Meilisearch through MEILI_ADDR for full-text search, and Deployz does not provide Meilisearch, so nothing shown proves the service is unneeded.
